title: Location-Based Safety Management with Wearable Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Positioning
summary: A wearable–cloud positioning architecture that combines GNSS, inertial, and barometric measurements with map-aware fusion for continuous indoor–outdoor localization. The system supports geofencing and real-time monitoring for industrial safety under device power and communication constraints.

title: A Black-Box Positioning Solution for Effortless Integration in Wearable Navigation
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
summary: Presents PDRS, a self-contained inertial positioning module that performs real-time sensor fusion on an embedded processor and provides position estimates through I²C, SPI, and UART. Hardware–software co-design simplifies integration into low-power wearable and IoT platforms.
note: Conference paper published in 2025; author manuscript deposited on arXiv in October 2026.

title: Real-time Pedestrian Dead Reckoning For IoT Based Platform-Independent Positioning System
venue: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
summary: An embedded pedestrian dead reckoning algorithm with acceleration-differential step detection and dynamic gyroscope bias updates. Processing inertial measurements directly on K-Tag reduces communication with the positioning server while supporting low-latency relative localization.

title: An IoT Based Approach for Platform Independent Positioning Service
venue: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation (IPIN)
summary: Extends the KAILOS indoor positioning architecture with a dedicated IoT device to decouple sensing and localization from smartphone operating-system restrictions. The hardware and software design supports platform-independent access to indoor positioning services.

title: Recommending the Workflow of Vietnamese Sign Language Translation via a Comparison of Several Classification Algorithms
venue: Computational Linguistics · PACLING 2019, Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol. 1215
summary: Evaluates classification methods within a Vietnamese Sign Language translation pipeline, focusing on the mapping from written Vietnamese to written sign-language sentences. The study informs model selection for preserving semantic content before visual gesture generation.

title: Design of automatic irrigation system for greenhouse based on LoRa technology
venue: 2018 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Communications (ATC)
summary: A LoRa-based wireless sensing and control network for greenhouse irrigation, integrating environmental data acquisition, remote monitoring, and automated irrigation control. The design connects distributed sensing with coordinated device communication for agricultural automation.
